B397.title: India Office B397, Status of the Islands of Tamb, Little Tamb, Abu Musa, and Sirri
B397.meaning: Contemporary British governmental evidence: Sirri effectively occupied by Persia since 1887; Persian claims to Tamb and Abu Musa remained contested. Not a modern sovereignty adjudication.

B399-1.title: India Office B399, Status of certain Groups of Islands in the Persian Gulf, folio 197r
B399-1.meaning: Lists Qeshm, Hengam, Hormuz, Larak, Lavan, Hindurabi, Kish and Farur as Persian. Begins discussion of Little Farur uncertainty.

B399-2.title: India Office B399, folio 197v
B399-2.meaning: Concludes Little Farur should be considered Persian with a slight doubt about Qawasim claim. Farsi/Arabi/Harqus ownership described as undetermined.

Turkey.title: Richard N. Schofield, Encyclopaedia Iranica, Boundaries v. With Turkey
Turkey.meaning: 1932 treaty changed the 1914 line, with another small 1937 rectification. Modern/NE proxy coordinates cannot be recertified as universally identical to 1922.

Shatt.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica, Boundaries i. With the Ottoman Empire
Shatt.meaning: 1913 river delimitation differed from later Shatt al-Arab thalweg arrangements. Modern and NE lines are proxies, not historical legal evidence.
